title: Cross-Cultural Transfer Learning for Chinese Offensive Language Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual zero-shot and few-shot transfer learning of multilingual language models trained on offensive language datasets from different cultural backgrounds (Western/English and Korean) and tested on a Chinese dataset to identify culture-specific biases in offensiveness perception.

Analyzing the fine-grained topic distributions of offensive language predictions to demonstrate that models trained on different cultural data (e.g., English) fail to classify region-related text as offensive in the target language (Chinese).

Evaluating model predictions on the race-related subset of the test data and using semantic similarity retrieval to highlight how identical race-related topics (e.g., anti-black discrimination) hold completely different offensive labels across varying cultural datasets.
Evaluating offensive language detection performance by analyzing the distribution of predictions on the gender-specific topic subset of the Chinese benchmark dataset.
